official_definition: You can send two cores from one of your "Contractor Lugh" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, for each Brave on that "Contractor Lugh", during this turn, all your "Martial" family Spirits gain an extra God symbol.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Martial Unleash] or [Martial Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Martial Unleash]", "give [Martial Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
